prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1147; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents a rear quarter panel dent with a cracked taillight lens and scuffing along the rear bumper cover, all of which lines up with the impact as it was described to us. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, refinishing the quarter panel, and swapping the lamp assembly, with labor hours set to match the extent of the deformation. Nothing on the car points to earlier damage in this area, and the invoices we reviewed show no duplicated line items or repeated charges. The estimate is ready for approval once the parts sourcing is confirmed.
